input.quote: 13.3 Customer may transfer its licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24. Vendor shall not revoke or suspend a licence except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure.
input.rationale: The licence package meets the preferred position in full. Section 13.1 grants access rights to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf" for their internal business purposes; Section 13.2 grants Customer and its Affiliates a "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence" for paid-up software and Vendor Technology (including material embedded in Deliverables, confirmed by Section 14.3); Section 13.3 limits any Vendor revocation or suspension of the subscription licence to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a cure opportunity, and permits transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor. That transfer right is fully effective because Section 24.1 lets Customer assign to an Affiliate or to an M&A successor without Vendor's consent, so the Section 24 cross-reference does not add a consent gate. Restrictions in Section 13.4 are limited and expressly do not limit use of Customer Data or authorized security testing. No redline is required.
